_comment: Template only. Copy to tools/script_<topic>.json before building. This file is deliberately NOT named script_* so it is never rendered.

scenes.title: Big Claim
scenes.text: Open with the single most surprising fact in the whole story, in about fifteen words.

scenes.title: Second Beat
scenes.text: Add the first linking sentence that carries the listener forward to the next moment.

scenes.title: Third Beat
scenes.text: Keep the chain going with a concrete number the narrator can say naturally.

scenes.title: The Turn
scenes.text: Introduce the problem or the thing that everyone thought could not be done.

scenes.title: The Surprise
scenes.text: Deliver the twist: something unexpected finally worked against the odds.

scenes.title: The Climax
scenes.text: Peak of the story: describe the moment that changed the record forever.

scenes.title: The Scale
scenes.text: Show how big it became, with one clean number the viewer can remember.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: Wrap the arc in one line and ask the viewer a question they will want to answer?
